Same synchronous callback/nonreentrancy plus source/runtime/input/serializer closure and fresh getter lineage remain mandatory. latestRootSourceObservations.topic: Host numeric parser cannot be used as metadata comparator unchanged
latestRootSourceObservations.assessment: Prearm strict_json uses default integer decoding, which normalizes JSON -0 to int0, and same compares exact Python types then equality. Thus its same rejects int1 vs float1.0 while equating float-0.0/+0.0. Metadata comparator instead preserves -0 and compares binary64 bytes across int/float. Future control-stage materializer must explicitly meet metadata numeric semantics. This is a prospective integration restriction, not a defect claim against approved prearm scope.
